trust_decision.summary: The CStudio chunked-upload script uses client-supplied strings directly as filesystem paths and enforces no authenticated session: $_POST['name'] becomes $fsDest in finishUpload, $_GET/$_POST['key'] becomes the temp-file path in uploadFile, and $_FILES['bigUploadFile']['name'] becomes the destination in postUnsupported, all under the plugin web tree with no extension or traversal restriction.

landing_point.why: finishUpload() concatenates the request-supplied $finalName onto $this->mainDirectory and hands it to writeStream, so it is the first place an engineer who read 'CStudio upload flow' opens; the chunk-key write at :133-152 and postUnsupported at :243-253 sit in the same class.

fix_sites.module_kind: legacy plugin HTTP script (procedural PHP, no Symfony controller)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Every fix site sits in one file; a solver can argue the CStudio AJAX uploaders in ajax/ are 'the document editor, not the import-project upload flow' that the advisory names.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The non-chunked branch must keep the user's original basename and extension: import-file.php only offers a file if isFileDirectUpload() matches the stored name's extension, and both import pages later look the file up by the name returned from finish. An over-broad fix that rewrites/flattens every name (the natural over-correction once one sanitizer is applied to all names) breaks legitimate 'my project v2.zip'/accented uploads.

O6_input_shapes: $_POST['key'] - chunk temp filename, overrides the GET value
absent/empty key - server-generated mt_rand() temp name that the client then echoes back

O7_producer.where: public/plugin/CStudio/editor/import-project/inc/big-upload.php:264-271 (request-supplied temp key used directly as the path component) and :157-160 (server produces the key it echoes back)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Blob/image cache upload endpoint: ?step moves 'img_cache/tmp/<name from GET name>' to 'img_cache/<folder>/<name>'; the non-step branch writes base64/uploaded data to that path
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It is the visual-editor blob uploader, a neighbouring feature with its own name handling, not the import-project flow the report describes.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Image URL cache: basename(ur) is written into img_cache/<localFolder>/ with the fetched remote content and no extension restriction; oel_ctr_rights() returns true when the session list is empty
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Reads from a URL rather than accepting an upload, and is guarded by oel_ctr_rights(), so a solver can call it a separate cache-priming route.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Zip import: namesrc archive is opened and every ZipArchive entry name is appended to the destination directory and written, with no '..' or extension check
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It is the post-upload import step behind a CSRF token, not the upload endpoint the fix changed.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same directory, different file (import.php vs inc/big-upload.php)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Post-import copy stage: tmpImgCache/filePathNg come straight from GET and files are listed and copied into that destination under the plugin tree, with no session check in the file
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It copies between plugin folders instead of accepting an upload, and an extension allowlist limits what is written.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second chunked uploader script for the 'scorm' and 'document' typeUpload variants, e.g. inc/big-upload-document.php, sharing the BigUpload class
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: form-upload.php already parameterises the same form by $typeUpload ('scorm'/'document'), so a maintainer splitting the uploader per type is a natural change.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A 'savetemp' action that writes ?name= into img_cache/tmp the way ?step= reads it, trusting the same GET name
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The file already has the tmp/ staging folder and an unsanitized name parameter in the step branch, so adding the matching writer is a small, plausible commit.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A create2-stage endpoint that copies 'img_cache/<name>' into the project folder using a GET-provided file name
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: create2 already builds file paths from GET values (fold, tmpFolderWork) and delegates copying to import-copy.php, so a maintainer could inline it per-file.

O9_family: Arbitrary file write from untrusted filename / path traversal (CWE-22) ending in unrestricted upload (CWE-434) and code injection (CWE-94); the advisory maps to CWE-219/22/434/94

O10_build.toolchain: Composer (chamilo/chamilo-lms project, Symfony bundles under src/, public/ document root), Doctrine migrations; PHP extensions bcmath/ctype/curl/dom/exif/fileinfo/gd/iconv/intl/ldap/mbstring listed in composer.json
services: web server with public/ as document root (Apache/nginx)
O10_build.project_tests: PHPUnit/Behat-style suites under tests/ for the Symfony bundles (tests/CoreBundle/**, tests/CourseBundle/**); no test covers public/plugin/CStudio or any upload endpoint

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: basename()/disable_dangerous_file() on $_POST['name'] inside finishUpload() only, leaving the attacker-controlled chunk key at :264-271 and the absent session check.
